topography.project_purpose: Decentralized Euro is a collateralized debt position (CDP) protocol that issues EUR-pegged stablecoins against various crypto assets. It also provides savings vaults, cross-chain bridges, and governance tokens to manage the system.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Decentralized Euro Core family provides the foundational CDP and stablecoin logic, while the Active EUR Stablecoin Bridges family extends it cross-chain. SavingsVault, MintingHub, PositionFactory, and PositionRoller families interact with the core to manage vaults, minting, and positions, and the DEPS/nDEPS tokens serve as governance and equity across the system.
